doc.projectIntro: This quote replaces QU-WADEBALES-001 (20 May 2026) and reflects the scope as now agreed. Both physical servers move into Rocking's Westlake facility on colocation, with a monthly boot-and-patch window on Server 1 so your team can apply patches remotely. Connectivity is a single Openserve fibre link with a fixed IP. Remote access is handled by locking the MikroTik firewall down to Hetzner's fixed inbound addresses and deploying Tailscale for your users. A wireless backup link is included as a placeholder — see the note below. All prices exclude VAT (15%).

items.detail: Physically receiving both servers, racking and cabling at Westlake, bringing them up, and verifying replication between them.

Firewall reconfigured to accept inbound traffic only from Hetzner's fixed IP addresses, and Tailscale deployed for remote access to the servers. Tailscale's free tier covers your usage (up to 6 users / 100 devices), so no licensing cost applies — this line is labour only.

items.description: Openserve Fibre — Once-Off Installation & Fixed IP Setup
items.detail: Installation of the 500Mbps Openserve link at Constantia, including configuration of the fixed IP address.
Both physical servers housed at Rocking's Westlake facility — powered, connected and kept online. Priced per server.
Rocking boots Server 1 each month so your team can remote in and apply whatever patching is required. Covers the boot and availability window only; patching itself is carried out by your team.
Single Openserve FTTH link at Constantia including a fixed IP address. No Openserve SLA applies to FTTH.

Wireless failover link as a secondary path. Pricing depends on which wireless providers hold a high site with line of sight above Constantia — we are confirming coverage and will quote this separately. Listed here so it is on record; it is not included in the totals below.

doc.summaryNote: This quote supersedes QU-WADEBALES-001. Two changes worth noting: the wireless WISP backup link is a placeholder with pricing to follow once we have confirmed which providers cover Constantia from a high site — it carries no cost in the totals above. Separately, a virtual server hosted at Teraco remains an option worth revisiting in future; it would remove the dependency on your own hardware, and we are happy to price it when the time is right.
terms: This quote is valid for 14 days from the date of issue.
All prices exclude VAT at 15% unless otherwise stated.
This quote replaces QU-WADEBALES-001 dated 20 May 2026.
Once-off costs are due prior to installation and commissioning.
Monthly recurring billing commences from the date of service activation.
Server colocation requires both servers to be delivered to Rocking's Westlake facility.
The monthly boot-and-patch window covers booting Server 1 and making it available; patching is performed by the client's team.
Tailscale is provided on its free tier (up to 6 users / 100 devices). Exceeding those limits would introduce a licensing cost, quoted separately.
Openserve FTTH does not carry an Openserve SLA.
The wireless WISP backup link is not priced in this quote and is subject to a separate quotation once coverage is confirmed.
Hardware remains the property of the client.

internal.note: Own labour (Andre + Trevor coordination) — receiving, racking, bringing up 2 servers, replication checks. Priced R1,500 ex VAT per Shawn (was not on QU-001). No external supplier cost.

Own labour (Andre) — MikroTik hard-lock to Hetzner fixed IPs + Tailscale deploy. Tailscale free tier (6 users/100 devices) = no licensing cost. Priced R1,500 ex VAT per Shawn; replaces QU-001's R2,500 Proxmox setup line.

Openserve FTTH once-off install + fixed IP setup, R1,500 ex VAT to client. QU-001 had install at R1,000/link; uplifted to R1,500 for the fixed IP. WHOLESALE INSTALL COST NOT SUPPLIED — margin unknown, confirm Openserve once-off before invoicing.
Colocation at Rocking's own Westlake facility — 2x physical servers @ R750/mo ex VAT each (same unit rate as QU-001 Option A, now x2). No external cost; power/rack space is ours.
Own labour — monthly boot of Server 1 so client patches remotely. R250/mo ex VAT per Shawn. New line, not on QU-001.

Openserve FTTH 500Mbps + fixed IP, R1,500/mo ex VAT to client (QU-001 Option B rate, 1 link not 2). WHOLESALE MONTHLY COST NOT SUPPLIED — margin unknown. Fixed IP may carry an additional wholesale charge; confirm before activation.
Wireless WISP backup link — TBC line, deliberately unpriced. Blocked on confirming which WISPs have a high site with LOS above Constantia. Not in totals.
